_meta.scope_caveat: All 252 originally identified candidate records enriched and checked with original source archive and aligned eight-site archival cross-index; public searches and official checks where possible. Not a logged-in full individual crawl of all eight sites per location.

policy.each_record: Original eight-source archived alignment + exact source URLs + searches for other-name/alias/candidate mentions + official geographical verification + dated report classification + duplicate avoidance. Preserve in record whether page opened, not indexed, authentication-restricted or not checked.
policy.preserve_reports: All dates, comments, links and descriptions, even negative or historical.
